result.stderr:
Usage: rp2350-gdb <image.uf2|image.bin> [options]

  --port <n>         GDB server port (default: 3333)
  --elf <path>       ELF with symbols (nanoCLR.elf). Enables the 'where' command and,
                     with --pe, a native-checksum preflight that warns when a deployed
                     assembly will be rejected by the CLR (CLR_E_ASSM_WRONG_CHECKSUM).
  --channel <c>      Serial output to echo: uart|usb|none (default: uart)
  --run              Start the CPU immediately (default: halted, so you can
                     set breakpoints before the first instruction runs)
  --pe <file|dir>    Build a deployment from compiled .pe assemblies and inject it
                     at 0x100FC000. Validates marker and CRCs, orders mscorlib
                     first, pads to 4 bytes. Repeatable; a directory takes
                     every .pe inside it.
  --emit-deployment <path>
                     Also write the assembled deployment image to disk, e.g. to
                     feed bin2uf2 --merge for the real board.
  --deploy <f>[@hex] Inject a raw binary at an address (default 0x100FC000)
  --diagnose <n>     Non-interactive: run n instructions, dump CPU + PIO, exit
  --check-run        Non-interactive: boot the firmware and report whether the
                     deployed app actually starts executing, or the CLR rejects
                     it and idles (e.g. CLR_E_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE). Needs --elf and
                     a deployment (--pe/--deploy).
  --mcp [port]       Serve the running machine over MCP on 127.0.0.1:<port>
                     (default 3334) so an agent can diagnose it: CPU and memory
                     inspection with no side effects, memory snapshots and diffs
                     to catch corruption, instrumented step/step-over, raw RSP
                     packet injection, and a report of every moment the debugger
                     and the simulation loop contended for the machine.
  --trace [file.log] TEMPORARY diagnostic trace: log every register/memory/step/
                  
[truncated]
